_notes: Each entry under files is the fixture file copied verbatim (same keys and values, re-serialised as JSON), keyed by its path in the hanko repo.
ryo_*.json use hanko FixtureFactsSource shape: {status, coverage, payload} where payload is what the RYO tool returned (hanko/ryotools/fixture.py). status=failed carries the transport error instead.
market_*.json are hanko market-fact snapshots (flat: subject, price_usd, volume_24h_usd, liquidity_usd, safety_score).
check_safety is NOT on RYO’s authenticated catalog (hanko DECISIONS.md D-06, 2026-09-05); it was on the hackathon’s public tool list. Canary uses it to exercise discovery of a seventh tool.

Per hanko/ryotools/facts.py and client.py (confirmed live 2026-09-05): analyze_token nests price and volume under data.market; the envelope carries schema_version/status/data_mode/data/summary/warnings/availability; deep_analysis token_profile was null; no holder-concentration field exists in the six tools.
TOKENA / TOKENB / TOKENC are hanko placeholder names, not real coins.
